result: If I could change the world in one way, I would eliminate poverty. Poverty is a root cause of so many other issues—hunger, lack of education, poor health, and even conflict. By ensuring everyone has access to basic needs like food, shelter, healthcare, and education, we could create a foundation for people to thrive and contribute meaningfully to society. This change would not only improve individual lives but also foster greater equality, stability, and opportunity worldwide.
